description: Build a headline labour-market profile for one reference area: labour force participation, employment-to-population ratio, unemployment and youth unemployment rates, youth NEET rate, informal employment rate, employment level, labour income share, and working poverty rate. Each indicator shows its latest reported value (from a national or institutional source, with its source and notes) and, separately, its latest ILO modelled estimate that is not a projection, each with its dataset, period, and status — a missing reported value stays missing and is never filled from the model. Accepts a country (ISO3, e.g. KEN) or an X-coded aggregate (X01 World, regions, income groups), for which only modelled values exist.

ref_area.description: One reference area with annual data: an ISO3 country code (KEN) or an X-coded aggregate (X01 World, X06, X02); ILO_GEO_ forms accepted, case-insensitive. ilostat_list_reference topic ref_areas lists them.

sex.description: SEX_T (default), SEX_M, or SEX_F; T/M/F and total/both/male/female are accepted. Indicators without a sex breakdown (labour income share) are unaffected.

name: ilostat_get_country_profile

attribution.description: Citation to keep with any use of the data.

catalog_as_of.description: ISO timestamp the catalog was last confirmed current.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_area`: ref_area is not an ILOSTAT reference area with annual data. `upstream_busy`: The server-side pacer shed the call, or the ILOSTAT API answered 429 or a challenge page. `catalog_unavailable`: No catalog snapshot has loaded and the load failed, or the first load has not finished within 30 s. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

indicators.description: The headline indicators, in a fixed order.

modelled.description: Latest non-projected ILO modelled estimate; absent when none exists.

dataset_id.description: Modelled dataset the value comes from.

value.description: Value; absent when upstream sent none.

reported.description: Latest reported value; absent when none exists.

items.description: One note attached to the value.

value.description: Value; absent when upstream sent none.

unit.description: Unit of both values (% or thousands).

modelled_cutoff_year.description: Latest year the modelled values could come from; later modelled years are projections.

notice.description: Which indicators have no reported value, and which of those have an ILO modelled estimate instead.

income_group.description: World Bank income group the area belongs to.

region.description: ILO region the area belongs to.

subregion.description: ILO broad subregion the area belongs to.

reported_missing.description: Keys with no reported value, including those that have no reported dataset.

title: Get an ILOSTAT labour-market profile
